ui.hero.title: One platform for every animal you care for
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily activities and team collaboration across all your facilities. Find any task in Antz, together with real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Tap any card to open its guide, together with every feature and its screens.
ui.cta.text: Every module has its features and real screens in this guide. Continue where you left off, or ask us and we will help you.
ui.day.title: What your first day on Antz is like
ui.day.1: Log in to your work area
ui.day.2: Learn to move around in the system
ui.day.3: Set up your main data (master data)
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that match your organization and switch on permissions module by module, so that everyone sees what their job needs.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The phone app handles field tasks, such as notes, treatments, transfers and egg records. The web app handles office tasks, such as the hospital system, nursery setup, reports and pharmacy stock. Updates appear instantly on phones, tablets and computers.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access depends on roles. You create the roles used in your organization, for example Animal Specialist (Zoologist), and switch on permissions module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We have more than one facility. Is that possible?
ui.faq.a4: Antz keeps data from every facility and department in one place. Housing is arranged by facility, section and enclosure, and transfers between facilities go through approval and an exit security check.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the Getting Started guide, then open the modules used by your role. If something is unclear, write to us through hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Carcass Examination (Necropsy)
m.necropsy.intro: The Carcass Examination module documents post-death examination together with detailed observations, findings for each organ, and a clinical conclusion. It supports accurate analysis of the cause of death, standardizes report writing, ensures timely handling of the carcass, and meets legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by facility, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Track the stages of transfer, Incoming, Pending, Draft, and Completed. [?]
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, place, cause, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Worm Medicine
m.deworming.intro: The Worm Medicine (Deworming) module helps to record and track in an orderly way treatments that control parasites, ensuring timely giving, accurate writing-up, and clear tracking of every worm medicine administration for each animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: View by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Worm medicine is arranged into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped, and Completed for easy tracking.
m.deworming.f2.title: Worm medicine management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a dose or record directly the medicine that was given together with its dates and information.
m.deworming.f3.title: Recording the administration
m.deworming.f3.desc: Records the medicine dose, batch number, method of giving the medicine, notes, and optional follow-up.
m.housing.title: Housing
m.housing.intro: The Housing module arranges animal housing across your facilities, sections and enclosures, so that every animal has a known place and every change is tracked. Access at every level depends on permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Facility management
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit facilities together with role-based permissions for secure and orderly access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section management
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit sections within the zoo (garden of animals), together with permission-based control for secure management.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure management
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and track each one for better management of animals and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Death of the Fetus
m.fetal-death.intro: The Death of the Fetus module records and manages events of fetus deaths within enclosures, recording the cause, time, and information about the animals involved. It supports veterinary care, monitoring of reproductive health, analysis of trends and better management of animal numbers.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Add a record of fetus death
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new events, cause, time, parents, animal information.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by facility, date, being born dead or destruction of pregnancy, species or gender.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: View death records
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Complete information, days since death, cause, identification number, enclosure, facility, gender.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg Management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Egg module tracks the full life cycle of eggs, from being laid to hatching or being moved to the nursery, ensuring accurate records, instant updates, and full tracking for better coordination and accountability between the nest, nursery and hatching teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Instant numbers, those in nests, those moved to the nursery, those marked as to be thrown away.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs together with parents, status, dates, species, notes, attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight, and the full Egg Journey Timeline.
m.administer-medicine.title: Giving of Medicine
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Giving Medicine (Administer) module completes the Treatment Records by turning medicine orders into workable treatment flows, enabling instant delivery of care to a single animal or a batch, in the field or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct medicine-giving record for a date you chose without writing a full treatment record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find records quickly and narrow the list by date, feature, Species, Controlled Drugs. [?]
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatments by date in four tabs, Pending, Given, Skipped, Suspended.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccination module manages the full vaccination cycle for animals, from scheduling and direct giving to tracking upcoming, pending, skipped and completed vaccinations. It ensures treatment on time, accurate recording of the medicine dose, and full tracking for disease prevention and compliance with clinical regulations.
m.vaccination.f1.title: View by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations are arranged into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped, and Completed for easy tracking.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or record directly the vaccination that was given together with dates and medicine information.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Recording the administration
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Records the medicine dose, batch number, method of giving the medicine, notes, and optional follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Medicine Shop (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: It enables fast, accurate, and traceable delivery of medical products directly to authorized doctors, ensuring requests are fulfilled on time and the stock count is updated automatically from medicine orders to the shelf, together with visibility of every batch and tracking of expiry dates at all times.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Instant insights about stock problems, loads, purchases, requests, usage, products that are expiring and those that move out quickly, together with visible trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Find records quickly by Request ID, doctor's name, or medicine shop.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master data (shelves and small shelves) [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by number of shelves/small shelves for quick access and updates, together with customizable data (packaging, measurements (UOM), medicine salts, drivers, manufacturers). [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Stock report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock per batch together with value and expiry date; mark products that have run low/expired; track those nearing expiry; manage escrow together with dispute resolution.
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and stock count management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track stock and expiry dates, record purchases/shipments, keep one shared ledger, handle substitutes/different types.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Medicine giving management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can order and give medicine, or take medicine directly from the medicine shop, all being recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Load management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing medicine loads and complete them within the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustments and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock changes (lost, broken, expired); keep an audit history; manage returns to suppliers; download reports of usage, returns, purchases and giving for finance and needs.
m.getting-started.title: Starting
m.getting-started.intro: The Getting Started guide explains the purpose of the app and leads new users through the important steps of setting up their profile, exploring the main features, and moving around the platform efficiently.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Logging in and Work Areas
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and access your work environment that was assigned to you.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Moving around and the Interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home page feed for updates, quick shortcuts, and the bottom panel for main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Carcass Examination / Giving Medicine / Pending Allocation
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting carcass examination (necropsy), administrative documents, and the following procedures of allocation or disposal before fully closing the record. [?]
m.getting-started.f4.title: Main Setup and Modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Set up master data, and explore modules such as Treatment Records, Housing, Eggs, Nutrition and Animal Management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalizing
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage your details, update your profile, and change the language you prefer.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the levels of access needed for secure operations.
